about: Ledger for every recorded sound and music bed in brand/sound/. A file not listed here must not be used. `file` is relative to brand/sound/. Allowed sources: CC0 (Kenney Interface Sounds, BigSoundBank), the Pixabay Content License and the Mixkit Free License (not items marked Restricted). Pixabay items can never be part of a sonic logo or trademark. Keep the Pixabay licence certificate (PDF) for each music bed, for YouTube Content ID claims. Synthesised sounds live in sgv/sfx.py, are owned outright and need no entry. SFX files in sfx/ and ambience/ are committed; music/ stays git-ignored (this ledger is the record; re-download from `source`). BPM values are estimates from onset analysis, ~ means approximate (half or double time possible).
